product_metadata.title: BOYASEN Ultra Soft Indoor Modern Area Rugs Fluffy Living Room Carpets for Children Bedroom Home Decor Nursery Rug (4 x 5 ft, Black)
features: SUPER SOFT AND FLUFFY-Our shaggy comfy area rugs are made of high quality material. It has 3 layers, soft tactile surface, memory form layer in the middle and non-slip backside. With total thickness of more than 4cm, these indoor rugs can provide a perfect touch for you and your loved ones.

LIGHT WEIGHT AND DURABLE-Unlike traditional heavy and thick living room carpet, our rugs are much more light-weighted. However with unique weaving technology, we made them very light and durable at the same time. They are very firm-waved and not easy to shedding and scattering.

MULTIPLE USE-You can use these rugs as area rugs, bath rugs, nursery rugs, play room rugs etc.. We provide different sizes for almost all indoor scenarios. Small size for kid’s room, study, dormitory, large size for living room, bedroom, playroom and more.

ELEGENT DECORATION-These colorful fluffy rugs are not only practical, they can also be a nice decoration in your house. We have different solid colors, gradient colors, patterns to match the tone of your house decoration. They will make your room looks even better.

EASY TO CLEAN-Our fluffy carpets are very easy to clean. Use a vacuum cleaner with carpet mode for daily cleaning and wet cloth with mild detergent for dirty spots, then air-dry in well-ventilated places. Rub the surface to make it full and fluffy again.
